title: governments/<id>/content/rules/tax_limit.yaml
description: A legal limit on how fast tax revenue may grow, tested against each budget (today the City's Home Rule Charter § 8.08 6% test, in config/tax_limit.json). Which lines count as tax revenue is listed in a separate CSV (today data/tax_limit_lines.csv). Keys starting with an underscore are comments.

^_.description: A comment for people reading the file; ignored by the scripts.

entity.description: Which government the test is for (today's file only; in a government's folder the folder says it).

fund.description: The fund whose tax revenue is tested.

limit_pct.description: The largest allowed rise over the year before, in percent.

first_year.description: The first budget year the rule applies to. Earlier years are not tested.

section.description: The section of the law or charter that sets the limit.

tested.description: Which budget columns are tested, and the figure each result is shown under.

measure.description: The figure name the result is shown under.

baseline_measure.description: The figure for the year before that the budget is compared with.

transition.description: A transition rule that may waive the limit for some years. The site quotes it and does not decide whether it applies.

section.description: The section with the transition rule.

budget_years.description: The budget years the transition note is shown for.
